earnings.title: Freeport Reports
highlights: Net income attributable to common stock in third-quarter 2026 totaled $1.2 billion, $0.81 per share, and adjusted net income attributable to common stock totaled $1.3 billion, $0.88 per share.
Consolidated sales totaled 749 million pounds of copper, 105 thousand ounces of gold and 22 million pounds of molybdenum in third-quarter 2026.
Operating cash flows totaled $2.0 billion, net of $0.4 billion of working capital and other uses, in third-quarter 2026.
Third-quarter 2026 production exceeded sales by approximately 11%, primarily reflecting in-process inventories at smelting operations in Indonesia.
Third-quarter 2026 sales of 749 million pounds were in line with the July 2026 estimate of 750 million pounds.

quotes.text: The Freeport team delivered strong financial results in the third quarter and achieved several important milestones to drive value and support future growth.

outlook: Consolidated sales are expected to approximate 3.0 billion pounds of copper, 649 thousand ounces of gold and 93 million pounds of molybdenum for the year 2026, including 875 million pounds of copper, 300 thousand ounces of gold and 22 million pounds of molybdenum in fourth-quarter 2026.
Average unit net cash costs were $2.07 per pound of copper in third-quarter 2026 and are expected to average $1.90 per pound of copper for the year 2026.

Assuming prices of $6.50 per pound for copper, $4,000 per ounce for gold and $32.00 per pound for molybdenum in fourth-quarter 2026, operating cash flows are expected to approximate $8.5 billion, net of $0.6 billion of working capital and other uses, for the year 2026.
Capital expenditures are expected to approximate $4.4 billion, including $3.0 billion for major mining projects, for the year 2026.
